source_records.note: Hyperuricaemia has no grade2; cognitive generic term has no grade4, but NCCP/SmPC Table2 supplies an explicit grade4 pathway.

conflicts.nccp: NCCP v2 says capsules must not be opened or dissolved.
conflicts.smpc: Current SmPC permits pharmacist-directed capsule suspension and enteral administration.
conflicts.resolution: Standard suite uses whole capsules. Swallowing difficulty or a different formulation requires pharmacy instructions; no unsupervised substitution.

conflicts.nccp: Eligibility says age >18 and lists patients with CNS involvement under ROS1.
conflicts.smpc: Adult ROS1 indication does not require CNS involvement; the adult trial enrolled age >=18.
conflicts.resolution: At age exactly18 or ROS1 without CNS involvement, verify MAP/source interpretation; do not invent an absolute prohibition.
